claim: State ownership and structural pricing only; no source annotation, product build, WPLTO, link identity, hardware, semantic or release claim.

oracle_policy.addresses: All expected addresses are independent constants from the accepted Phase-A inventory and the 1.5 Halt-1 contract; none is read from a linker script under test.
oracle_policy.identity: An optimizer-emitted payload size is observation, not an ownership constant. A smaller payload is still red when exact far-body identity is required.
oracle_policy.fit: Bank-0, zero page, far payload/owner range, stack, fixed state and overlay are one simultaneous-live set.

ordinary-bank0-bss.initialization: CRT zeroes the complete arena before main; session operations preserve it unless their existing subsystem initializer changes a member.

ordinary-zero-page.initialization: .zp.data is copied, .zp.bss is zeroed and .zp.noinit retains its existing compiler-defined noinit semantics.

convergence-bank0-state.initialization: Per-submit descriptors and witness bytes are initialized by the convergence primitive before consumption.

convergence-zero-page.initialization: Per-submit completion scratch is initialized by the convergence primitive; no boot persistence is claimed.

fixed-c2-bank0-state.initialization: Existing C2 ownership, phase and subsystem initialization contracts remain unchanged.

compiler-static-stack.initialization: NOLOAD compiler stack; contents are not persistent state and capacity is fail-closed.

mapped-far-service-body.initialization: Immutable code is staged and independently read back before resident entry; it is never loaded through the refill seam it protects.

candidate_rows.far_body: red: 1433-byte whole-product LTO payload remains optimizer-owned against exact 1499-byte identity
